# Third-party code

`mimic_cxr_section_parser.py` is a copy of `txt/section_parser.py` of
[MIT-LCP/mimic-cxr](https://github.com/MIT-LCP/mimic-cxr), distributed under the MIT licence in
`LICENSE.mimic-cxr-code.txt`. It splits a MIMIC-CXR report into its sections; `medres data cxr-report` uses it to
take the findings and the impression of every training report.
